items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: It was King Oliver's date. It was in his name but he didn't play. Louis Metcalf played.

ctx.x: So, actually he didn't make the date.
It was King Oliver's date. It was in his name but he didn't play. Louis Metcalf played.
You mean Metcalf like ghosted for him and said this was King Oliver or did they give Louis Metcalf credit on the record?
